## Verdict
REVISE — staged replay is appropriate, but baseline mapping, mixed-state replay, and durable publication need implementable contracts.
## Critical gaps
Specify whole-layer versus per-file reversal, including created/deleted files and mixed publication states; never skip failed reversals unless the recovered touched-file baseline verifies exactly.
## Important improvements
Use lock.inputs entries named atl/art/bionic and filenames *.tar.gz; Input exposes no revision. Validate archive-member mapping explicitly; stream only touched regular members, rejecting duplicates, links and unsafe ancestors. Rehash cached bytes against archive-derived digests, not merely cache-supplied fingerprints.
## Validation gaps
Test exact-offset rejection separately from fuzz=0; mixed-layer/file states, absent-file collisions, unrelated drift within touched files, and generated patched-header mismatches. Report mismatches without exemptions; leave unpatched generated files outside verification. Inject replace/fsync failures and restart after each published file; verify no success markers and enforce bounded disk/memory.
## Recommended revision
Parse ordered paths and absence states → verify archives and bounded touched-file baseline/cache → stage, reverse applicable layers, compare exact baseline, replay all layers exactly → recheck preimages under existing CLI build lock → durable journal or explicit fail-closed publication, preserving modes and fsyncing files/directories → integrate helper fingerprints and run planned checks without full ART copying.
